messages.content: Write one factual historical paragraph of at most 93 words. Use only the source notes.

{"task": "Give the sponsor and draft symbol, adoption date, vote and resolution number. Give the mandate expiry, readiness for review after six months and island-wide reach. Attribute the parties' unchanged positions to the Council President and distinguish them from the Council's consensus. Name the Council's settlement framework.", "evidence": [{"id": "vote", "text": "On 30 January 2023, at S/PV.9252, the United Kingdom submitted S/2023/64. Japan presided. The Council adopted the draft unanimously, 15 in favour, as resolution 2674 (2023)."}, {"id": "positions", "text": "The Council President reported that in meetings with representatives of the parties, the parties confirmed they maintained their established positions. The Council proceeded to the vote with its members' consent. The President did not report any settlement between the parties."}, {"id": "mandate", "text": "The Council extended UNFICYP's mandate through 31 January 2024 and expressed readiness to review implementation after six months. It stressed that UNFICYP's mandated authority extends throughout Cyprus and called for cooperation and respect for freedom of movement."}, {"id": "settlement", "text": "The Council recalled the goal of a bicommunal, bizonal federation with political equality. It urged the sides to agree on the Secretary-General's proposal for a United Nations envoy to assist the search for common ground."}]}
